The utensil drawer appears to be briefly closed near frame 1104 and reopened by frame 1112, so those approach/manipulation cycles are retained as separate episodes.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user sequentially opens and closes closet doors, a refrigerator, an upper cabinet, and a utensil drawer.
